content: hello again formal conjectures team, for my second PR i again wanted something close to an existing conjecture in the repo, so i've added Goldfeld's conjecture, that for an elliptic curve over Q, half the twists have rank 0 and half rank 1, when ordered by height. this is very similar to the existing half_rank_zero_and_half_rank_one whose format i have copied. PR is here. note that by work of Smith this is known to follow from BSD.
